features.name: Configuration layer
features.description: pydantic-settings BaseSettings in app/config/ — every model, provider, and threshold env-swappable (main_model, extraction_model, safety_model, stt/tts_provider, session_minutes, course_sessions, turn_end_vad_thresholds, silence_checkin_seconds). Model-agnosticism hard rule: nothing hardcoded, all via LiteLLM + config.

tests.notes: Env-var mapping, default overrides, and required-field-raises-when-unset covered.

features.notes: Prerequisite for every other feature — every module reads settings.

features.name: Graph state schemas
features.description: SessionState and CourseState LangGraph TypedDicts in app/graph/state.py, per implementation.md §5.1 and §4.1. SessionState: phase, elapsed_minutes, exchange_count, baseline_affect, primary_thread, dropped_threads, key_words_used, language_map, body_locations_mentioned, tentative_pattern, interruption_events, audio_affect. CourseState: session_number, course_phase, session_summaries, formulation, next_session_intention, unresolved_threads.

tests.notes: Schema defaults, override merge, transient turn channels, nested shapes.

features.name: Safety node (L1 lexicon + L2 small-model gate)
features.description: app/graph/nodes/safety.py — 3-layer crisis safety per impl §7.8. L1 high-precision lexicon (English + romanized Hindi, zero latency); L2 zero-shot small-model strict-JSON classifier via LiteLLM, recall-tuned, gates the phase agent (parallel branch). Crisis routing never runs through the main therapist model.

tests.notes: 14 tests: L1 hits/misses incl. romanized Hindi + suicide-prevention negation; L2 strict-JSON parse; parse-failure returns non-crisis.

subtasks.name: L2 zero-shot classifier node via LiteLLM

features.notes: L3 (fine-tuned classifier) deliberately deferred — research deliverable, not a prerequisite (impl §7.8).

features.name: Register classifier
features.description: app/graph/nodes/register.py — register score 0-2 (formal-en/hinglish/hindi-led) plus continuous CMI (Code-Mixing Index) per utterance. v0 rule-based particle heuristics from methodology.md §3.3; upgrades to audio-feature + transcript classifier later.

tests.notes: CMI pure/balanced/empty cases; register 0/1/2 mapping; particle detection; register_node partial update shape.

features.name: Affect-from-audio node
features.description: app/graph/nodes/affect.py — audio affect: arousal_delta, flat_prosody_streak. v0 is a schema-only stub per impl §7.5; baseline_affect measured from audio (pace/volume/pitch/flatness), feeds crisis detection and session state.

tests.notes: Stub returns schema-valid defaults; real signal extraction deferred.

features.notes: Deliberately stubbed v0; real audio feature extraction is later work.

features.name: State extraction node
features.description: app/graph/nodes/extraction.py — separate lightweight small-model extraction call after each exchange (impl §5.2), updates SessionState and emits next_technique (response-act). Grounded in PIECE (plan-before-summarize) and READER (response-act prediction). Auditable, deterministic.

tests.notes: 9 tests: strict-JSON parse (fenced/prose/garbage); diff-merge append-don't-wipe; next_technique clamped to canonical set; settings.extraction_model used; parse-failure degrades safely.

features.notes: One of the two accepted serial LLM hops — must use small/fast model.

features.name: Phase agent nodes (5)
features.description: app/graph/nodes/phases/{landing,opening,deepening,meaning,closing}.py — five phase-specialized therapist agents, each with scoped prompt (§6.1) and its phase's technique subset as callable tools. Conditional edge selects by session.phase. Realizes methodology.md §6.10 techniques-as-tools (Baldo et al.).

tests.notes: 8 tests: each node returns {'response': main-model text} and uses settings.main_model; per-phase prompt markers (Landing max-1-question/present-moment, Deepening silence permission + body question, Closing no-new-threads/carry-forward); session state + language mode + next_technique ride in the prompt.

features.notes: Five nodes share prompt scaffolding (persona, language mode, session state, safety rules, key directives) in _common.py; each adds its own phase block + technique subset. All share identical async signature for F010's conditional edge.

features.name: Crisis node
features.description: app/graph/nodes/crisis.py — crisis protocol response (acknowledge with warmth, stop exploration, speak resources slowly + surface on screen, stay present, never hang up) and parallel human notification (emergency contact, minimal metadata). Fires emergency contact notification per methodology §7.3.

tests.notes: 7 tests: protocol prompt (warmth + helpline) via settings.main_model; model-failure fallback speaks helpline; crisis_surface payload; notification skip-when-no-contact; sent payload is minimal-metadata-only.

features.notes: Depends on F003 (safety gate routes here). Notification is a logged outbound signal in v0 — SMS/push transport is deployment-time.

features.name: Course graph (synthesis + planner)
features.description: app/graph/nodes/course/{synthesis,planner}.py — post-session graph (impl §4.2): synthesis extracts per-session summary against the counseling-components schema (ConSum/MentalCLOUDS); planner updates formulation, evaluates course-phase milestones (§4.3: pattern across ≥2 sessions, patient-confirmed insight), sets next_session_intention. Runs async after session close.

tests.notes: Milestone predicates are pure functions of CourseState — test Foundation→Exploration→Working→Termination transitions incl. calendar-bounded session 8.

features.name: Turn graph assembly
features.description: app/graph/turn_graph.py — assembles the per-turn LangGraph (impl §7.3): L1 lexicon gate → crisis edge OR parallel [L2 safety ‖ register ‖ affect ‖ extraction] → join → phase_agent[session.phase] conditional edge → END. Uses PostgresSaver checkpointer (thread_id participant:{id}:session:{n}).

tests.notes: Topology: crisis routing never runs the phase agent; join waits on L2-safe; conditional edge selects correct phase agent.

features.notes: Depends on F002, F003-F007. Runs inside FastAPI process.

features.name: Voice pipeline (Pipecat)
features.description: app/voice/pipeline.py + timers.py — Pipecat pipeline (websocket transport) + silero VAD, per impl §7.7. Two distinct timers: phase-dependent turn-end VAD threshold (Deepening > Landing) vs the 90-second silence soft check-in (one utterance, never repeated). Stream-scoped; owns cancellation on barge-in.

tests.notes: Timer logic as pure functions (phase → VAD threshold); silence check-in fires once; timers never conflated.

features.notes: Pipecat may need system audio deps (check docs).

features.name: Voice provider services
features.description: app/voice/services/{sarvam_stt,rumik_tts,bulbul_tts}.py — STTProvider/TTSProvider async streaming protocols (impl §7.9). Sarvam Saaras STT, Rumik Mulberry/Muga TTS, Sarvam Bulbul TTS. TTS implementations own script normalization at the TTS boundary (romanized → Devanagari for Mulberry, §2.2) and phase prosody directives merged into the TTS call (§7.7).

tests.notes: Interface conformance; script-normalization correctness (Romanized Hindi → Devanagari); provider selection via config only.

subtasks.name: Bulbul TTS + script normalization at boundary

features.notes: Providers are eval-time swappable — never a default. Requires keys in .env.

features.name: Barge-in / interruption capture
features.description: app/voice/interruptions.py — patient speech during TTS playback cancels the stream instantly; captures truncated AI text + phase + minute → interruption_event appended to the next turn's SessionState.interruption_events (impl §7.7, methodology §6.8).

tests.notes: Capture produces schema-valid interruption_event; model never restarts the interrupted sentence.

features.notes: Owned by voice layer, not the graph.

features.name: Storage (DB, crypto, course store)
features.description: app/storage/{db,crypto,course_store}.py — PostgreSQL async engine (SQLAlchemy 2.0 + psycopg), LangGraph PostgresSaver checkpointer, Fernet app-layer encryption of session content at rest, CourseState persistence. Deletion cascades checkpointer thread + course rows. DPDP-aligned if ever deployed (impl §5.5).

tests.notes: Encrypt/decrypt round-trip; course store CRUD; deletion cascade.

features.notes: Depends on F001 (database_url). Postgres from day one.

features.name: Server (FastAPI control surface + /ws)
features.description: app/server/main.py + static/ — single FastAPI process serving the minimal static control-surface page (crisis resources + session controls + memory controls) and the /ws Pipecat voice endpoint. No REST /api/v1/, no text-chat mode. Runs turn-graph invocations and the voice loop.

tests.notes: Control surface serves crisis resources; /ws endpoint wires Pipecat; no conversational text mode.
